{"consolidated_memory":"## Loss Divergence in ml/train/loop.py - Three Separate Incidents

All occurrences involve the same symptom (loss curve turning upward and never returning) in ml/train/loop.py on the ml pipeline side, reproducible by training two epochs on the small split, with test coverage in tests/ml/test_train_loop.py.

**Incident 1 - [2026-01-21]**
- Trigger: only manifested for users sitting in a negative UTC offset
- Root cause: a listener registered but never removed
- Fix: removed the listener on teardown and asserted it in a test
- PR: #2193 on branch fix/loss-divergence-1
- Result: job completion time improved from 8 hours to 39 minutes

**Incident 2 - [2026-04-27]**
- Trigger: only manifested when the input list came in empty
- Root cause: missing Unicode normalisation before hashing
- Fix: normalised to NFC ahead of the digest
- PR: #3560 on branch fix/loss-divergence-2
- Result: cold start performance improved by 53 percent, down to 287 ms

**Incident 3 - [2026-08-21]**
- Trigger: only manifested on the first request after a cold start
- Root cause: a race in lazy initialisation
- Fix: guarded the init with a double-checked lock
- PR: #6482 on branch fix/loss-divergence-4
- Result: the backlog cleared 17 minutes after the deploy"}
